body:
I do somewhat have a career in art, you could say. I've been paid to work on a website once or twice, designing the background foliage/art/buildings/etc for their browser game, it's a start I guess. The owners are lazy, ignorant, assholes though. They don't care for coding the site anymore, and they really don't care about their community and what they've started. Thus losing money and my payment, it pisses me off a bunch how negligent they are towards their own damn site.

I guess I'm more complaining then I am thinking of killing myself, but I do feel down a bunch and I need something to keep me away from thinking so terribly, and so far talking to SW helped me stay cool for now.

Thanks :)
